courses.title: Research Methodology
courses.description: Learn to design rigorous, ethical research studies from the ground up — moving from a research question to a complete, runnable protocol.

problem.heading: Why Most Research Projects Fail Before They Start
problem.lead: Many research projects struggle because the foundation is weak long before data collection begins.
problem.calloutTitle: Stop Guessing How Research Is Done
problem.calloutBody: Learn a practical framework for designing publishable research studies from start to finish — so every decision, from your question to your protocol, is deliberate and defensible.

outcomes.heading: What You Will Be Able To Do
outcomes.lead: By the end of this course, you will understand how to design and structure a complete research project from idea to protocol.

pageContent.curriculumLead: Twelve structured modules that take you from your first research idea to a complete, executable study protocol.

inside.heading: Research Concepts Covered
inside.lead: Master the core concepts that underpin high-quality healthcare research.

handsOn.heading: Design Your Own Research Project
handsOn.lead: Build your own research project as you progress through the course. By the end, you'll have a complete study framework ready for implementation — not just notes, but a real plan you can act on.

cards.title: Develop Your Own Research Question
cards.body: Turn a clinical problem or knowledge gap into a clear, answerable research question.

cards.title: Build Your Own Methodology
cards.body: Choose the right design, sampling, and variables and assemble them into a coherent method.

cards.title: Create Data Collection Tools
cards.body: Design questionnaires, forms, and case report tools that capture clean, usable data.

cards.title: Prepare For Data Analysis
cards.body: Set up your variables and plan so your project flows smoothly into the analysis stage.

highlights.heading: From Research Idea to Study Protocol
highlights.lead: Learn how to transform an idea into a structured and executable research project — and see how every piece fits into one complete protocol.
highlights.closingNote: By the end, you'll see exactly how every piece fits together into a complete, implementation-ready research project.

assessment.heading: Assignments & Certification
assessment.lead: Learning is reinforced through assessments and a capstone protocol project — and earns you a verifiable certificate.

steps.title: Complete all modules
steps.body: Work through every module and its lessons at your own pace.

steps.title: Pass module quizzes
steps.body: Each module includes a quiz — you must score at least 70%.

steps.title: Submit the final project
steps.body: The course concludes with a complete research protocol as your final assessment.

steps.title: Earn your certificate
steps.body: Achieve the required passing score to receive your Certificate of Completion.

audience.heading: Who This Course Is For
audience.lead: Built for healthcare professionals who want to design and run their own research projects.
items: Individuals Planning Their Own Research Projects

enrollCta.heading: Build Research Projects With Confidence
enrollCta.body: Move from a research idea to a complete, publication-ready study protocol—without guessing what comes next.
enrollCta.extraLine: From your first research question to a protocol ready for ethics approval.

pageContent.subtitle: Learn how to turn a research idea into a complete study protocol ready for implementation, data collection, and publication.

modules.title: Study Designs
modules.description: This module helps you understand when and why to use cross-sectional, cohort, case-control, randomized controlled trial, diagnostic, and ecological study designs. Selecting the appropriate study design is one of the most important decisions in any research project.

courses.title: Statistics & SPSS
courses.description: Master practical biostatistics and learn how to independently analyze research datasets using SPSS.

problem.heading: Why Most Researchers Struggle With Statistics
problem.lead: If any of these sound familiar, you're not alone — and they're exactly what this course is built to fix.
items: Not knowing which statistical test to choose
Fear of making mistakes in data analysis
Dependence on statisticians for simple analyses
Difficulty writing Methods and Results sections
Lack of confidence when interpreting results
problem.calloutTitle: Stop Guessing Which Statistical Test To Use
problem.calloutBody: Learn a practical framework for choosing the correct analysis, interpreting SPSS output, and reporting your results with confidence — so you can analyze your own research data without relying on anyone else.

outcomes.heading: What You Will Be Able To Do
outcomes.lead: Learn how to choose the correct statistical test, analyze data in SPSS, interpret results, and write publication-ready Methods and Results sections.
items: Write publication-ready Methods and Results sections
Independently analyze your own research data

pageContent.curriculumLead: Ten structured modules that take you from the basics of SPSS to writing publication-ready results.

inside.heading: Analyses Covered
inside.lead: Learn the statistical techniques most commonly used in healthcare research.

handsOn.heading: Analyze Your Own Dataset
handsOn.lead: Apply what you learn to real research projects. Throughout the course you can work on your own datasets or follow along with the provided research datasets — the course is built around practical application, not memorization.

cards.title: Use Your Own Research Data
cards.body: Bring your own dataset and analyze it step by step as you progress through the course.

cards.title: Follow Along With Provided Datasets
cards.body: Prefer to practice first? Work through realistic research datasets included with the course.

cards.title: Real Research Applications
cards.body: Every technique is taught in the context of genuine clinical and research scenarios.

cards.title: Practical Decision-Making
cards.body: Learn how to choose, justify, and defend the right analysis for any research question.

handsOn.closingNote: You won't simply learn how statistical tests work — you'll learn how to use them on realistic research datasets, with worked examples you can apply to your own projects immediately.

highlights.heading: From SPSS Output to Publication-Ready Results
highlights.lead: Learn how to transform statistical analyses into publishable scientific writing. Most statistics courses stop after teaching software and tests — this course goes further.
highlights.closingNote: The goal isn't merely running analyses — it's communicating your results effectively in scientific manuscripts.

assessment.heading: Assignments & Certification
assessment.lead: Learning is reinforced through assessments and a capstone project — and earns you a verifiable certificate.

steps.body: Work through every module and its lessons at your own pace.

steps.title: Pass module assessments
steps.body: Each module contains assessments — you must score at least 70%.

steps.title: Submit the final project
steps.body: The course concludes with an independent dataset analysis project.

steps.title: Earn your certificate
steps.body: Achieve the required passing score to receive your Certificate of Completion.

audience.heading: Who This Course Is For
audience.lead: Built for healthcare professionals who want to analyze their own research data with confidence.

enrollCta.heading: Become Independent in Statistical Analysis
enrollCta.body: Learn how to choose the correct statistical test, analyze data in SPSS, interpret results confidently, and write publication-ready Methods and Results sections.
enrollCta.extraLine: From SPSS output to publication-ready results.

pageContent.subtitle: Learn how to independently analyze research data, choose the correct statistical tests, interpret SPSS output, and write publication-ready Methods and Results sections.

courses.title: Scientific Writing
courses.description: Turn your results into a clear, publishable manuscript and write every section of a scientific paper with confidence.

problem.heading: Why So Many Research Projects Never Become Publications
problem.lead: Many researchers successfully complete studies but struggle when it is time to write the manuscript.
items: Journal rejection due to writing quality
problem.calloutTitle: Stop Staring At A Blank Document
problem.calloutBody: Learn a practical framework for writing scientific manuscripts from title page to submission — so every section has a clear structure and a clear purpose.

outcomes.heading: What You Will Be Able To Do
outcomes.lead: By the end of this course, you will be able to independently write and prepare scientific manuscripts for publication.

pageContent.curriculumLead: Twelve structured modules that take you from a blank document to a complete, submission-ready manuscript.

inside.heading: Writing Skills Covered
inside.lead: Master the essential skills required to write and publish scientific papers.

handsOn.heading: Build A Publication-Ready Manuscript
handsOn.lead: Throughout the course, you can apply concepts directly to your own research project or follow along using provided examples. By the end, you'll have a complete manuscript draft suitable for journal submission after final refinement.

cards.title: Build Your Own Introduction
cards.body: Frame your background, establish the gap, and state clear objectives.

cards.title: Write Your Own Methods
cards.body: Describe your design, participants, and analysis with reproducible precision.

cards.title: Report Your Own Results
cards.body: Present findings clearly in text, tables, and figures — without interpretation.

cards.title: Draft Your Own Discussion
cards.body: Interpret your findings, compare with the literature, and frame the implications.

highlights.heading: Your Publication Journey
highlights.lead: See how individual writing skills come together — from finished research results to a submitted, publication-ready manuscript.
highlights.closingNote: By the end, you'll know how to carry a project from finished results all the way to a submitted, publication-ready manuscript.

assessment.heading: Assignments & Certification
assessment.lead: Learning is reinforced through assessments and a capstone manuscript project — and earns you a verifiable certificate.

steps.body: Work through every module and its lessons at your own pace.

steps.title: Pass module quizzes
steps.body: Each module includes a quiz — you must score at least 70%.

steps.title: Submit the final project
steps.body: The course concludes with a complete manuscript as your final assessment.

steps.title: Earn your certificate
steps.body: Achieve the required passing score to receive your Certificate of Completion.

audience.heading: Who This Course Is For
audience.lead: Built for healthcare professionals who want to turn their research into published manuscripts.

enrollCta.heading: Publish Research With Confidence
enrollCta.body: Master manuscript writing, journal submission, reviewer responses, and the path from research findings to publication.
enrollCta.extraLine: Turn unfinished drafts into published papers with confidence.

pageContent.subtitle: Learn how to transform research findings into clear, professional, publication-ready manuscripts.

modules.title: Writing The Methods Section
modules.description: The Methods section is where most manuscripts are won or lost in review. This module shows you how to describe your design, participants, variables, and analysis with the precision and reproducibility journals expect.

modules.title: Writing The Discussion Section
modules.description: The Discussion section is where research findings are interpreted, compared with existing literature, and translated into meaningful conclusions. Many manuscripts are weakened by poor discussion writing despite having strong data — this module gives you a practical framework for writing clear, persuasive, and publication-ready discussions.

courses.title: Systematic Reviews & Meta-Analysis
courses.description: Plan and complete a systematic review and meta-analysis that meets publication standards, from search to pooled effects.

problem.heading: Why Most Systematic Reviews Fail
problem.lead: Conducting a systematic review requires much more than searching PubMed.

outcomes.heading: What You Will Be Able To Do
outcomes.lead: By the end of this course, you will be able to plan, execute, and publish a complete systematic review and meta-analysis.

pageContent.curriculumLead: Twelve structured modules that take you from your review question to a published, PRISMA-compliant evidence synthesis.

inside.heading: Systematic Review Skills & Tools Covered
inside.lead: Master the methods — and the software — that turn a search into a publishable evidence synthesis.

handsOn.heading: Build Your Own Systematic Review
handsOn.lead: Develop your own review topic alongside the lessons. By the end of the course, you'll have a complete systematic review framework ready for execution.

cards.title: Develop Your Question
cards.body: Frame a focused PICO question with a clear scope and review objective.

cards.title: Build Your Search Strategy
cards.body: Combine keywords, MeSH terms, and Boolean logic into a defensible search.

cards.title: Create Screening Workflow
cards.body: Set inclusion criteria and run title, abstract, and full-text screening.

cards.title: Prepare Extraction Forms
cards.body: Design extraction sheets that capture every variable your review needs.

highlights.heading: The Complete Review Process
highlights.lead: Every stage of a systematic review and meta-analysis, end to end.

assessment.heading: Assignments & Certification
assessment.lead: Learning is reinforced through assessments and a capstone systematic-review project — and earns you a verifiable certificate.

audience.heading: Who This Course Is For
audience.lead: Built for healthcare professionals who want to synthesize evidence into high-quality, publishable reviews.

enrollCta.heading: Master Evidence Synthesis
enrollCta.body: Learn how to develop PRISMA-compliant reviews, search databases systematically, assess risk of bias, understand meta-analysis, and produce publication-ready evidence syntheses.
enrollCta.extraLine: From your first research question to your final PRISMA diagram — one course, one complete workflow.

pageContent.subtitle: Learn how to systematically identify, evaluate, synthesize, and publish research evidence using internationally recognized methodologies.

modules.title: Introduction to Meta-Analysis
modules.description: Many researchers want to learn meta-analysis but struggle because they never fully understand the systematic review process that comes before it. This module introduces the core concepts behind meta-analysis and helps you understand how pooled evidence is generated and interpreted.
